title: Chapter 18
text: About the Author SEQUOIA NAGAMATSU is a Japanese American writer and managing editor of Psychopomp Magazine , an online quarterly dedicated to innovative prose. Originally from Hawaii and the San Francisco Bay Area, he holds an MFA in creative writing from Southern Illinois University and a BA in anthropology from Grinnell College. His work has appeared in such publications as Conjunctions , The Southern Review , ZYZZYVA , Fairy Tale Review , and Tin House , among others. He is the author of the award-winning short story collection Where We Go When All We Were Is Gone and works as an associate professor of creative writing at St. Olaf College. He currently lives in Minnesota with his wife, their cat, and a robot dog named Calvino. Discover great authors, exclusive offers, and more at hc.com .
